notes: Barrick Gold Corporation renamed to Barrick Mining Corporation in 2025. NYSE: B (formerly GOLD); TSX: ABX. FY2025 attributable gold production 3.26 Moz (3.00 Moz excluding divested Hemlo and Tongon), in line with original guidance of 3.15-3.50 Moz; attributable copper production 220 kt. 2025 TCC $1,199/oz and AISC $1,637/oz on attributable sold ounces. Consolidated silver production not disclosed in the annual report. Q4 2025 portfolio actions: Hemlo sold to Carcetti Capital Corp (closed Nov 26, 2025); Tongon sold to Atlantic Group (closed Dec 1, 2025); Donlin Gold (50%) and Alturas projects divested; control of Loulo-Gounkoto regained Dec 16, 2025. $484M goodwill impairment at Loulo-Gounkoto; $655M impairment reversal at Lumwana. Mark Hill became President and CEO on Sept 29, 2025. Board authorized preparations for an IPO (IPOCo) of North American gold assets (NGM interests, Pueblo Viejo, Fourmile), expected to complete by late 2026. Mine-level production figures sum to 3,255 koz, matching the reported Total Gold 3,255 koz. Report URL confirmed as the actual download source of the PDF on file (per the background download completion record): https://minedocs.com/31/Barrick-AR-2025.pdf, which serves the identical 135-page 'Annual Report 2025' (also independently verified via web search).

mines.processing: Project in pre-feasibility (PFS expected 2028)
mines.mine_notes: 100% Barrick-owned Nevada asset adjacent to Goldrush, potential standalone Tier One gold asset. Indicated resources 4.6 Mt @ 17.59 g/t = 2.6 Moz (doubled in 2025); inferred 25 Mt @ 16.9 g/t = 13 Moz. $91M spent in 2025; decline development to begin late 2026 (phase cost $330-430M to mid-2029). Planned inclusion in the NGM JV at fair market value after feasibility; part of proposed IPOCo IPO (NGM + Pueblo Viejo + Fourmile) expected by late 2026.
